column1: # OpenShell profile to OpenCode provider mapping for opencode-oss.
#   opencode-provider  OpenCode provider ID (the part before "/" in --model)
#   env-var            credential env var the profile binds
#   example-model      a model ID from the image's bundled catalog
# Provider IDs and models come from `opencode models --standalone` in
# opencode-agent:local (OpenCode 2.1.4). One env var can enable sibling
# OpenCode providers (KIMI_API_KEY also enables kimi-code-plan-cn; ZHIPU_API_KEY
# also enables zai and zhipuai*); only the provider named here has an endpoint
# in its profile, so use that one.
